name: Brașov
tagline: Saxon old town and the castles of Transylvania
summary: Brașov is a Saxon-built Transylvanian town under the forested Tâmpa mountain. Stroll the Council Square and the Gothic Black Church, ride the cable car to the Hollywood-style sign, and use the town as a base for Bran Castle (sold as Dracula's), the fairy-tale Peleș Castle, fortified Saxon churches and bear-watching in the Carpathians.
seasonNote: Summer for hiking and castles; the Christmas market and skiing at Poiana Brașov in winter.
arrival: Trains from Bucharest take 2.5 to 3 hours; Brașov airport has a few flights.
gettingAround: Walk the old town; trains to Sinaia, buses or a car for Bran and Râșnov.
cashTip: Cards work in towns; carry lei for villages, castles and parking. Tip about 10 percent.
foodTip: Sarmale (cabbage rolls) with polenta, papanași doughnuts, ciorbă soups and mici sausages.
buyTip: Local honey, țuică plum brandy and hand-painted ceramics.
